column1: # C Programming Assessment 8 - String Questions (CSV Format)
Below is your CSV data. **Copy everything from the code block below** and save it as a `.csv` file:
Digital Library Card System,"**A library management system handles member registration with different string initialization approaches:**

**What distinguishes a properly formed string from a regular character array in C?**","In C, a string is a character array that must end with a null terminator '\0'. This special character tells string functions where the string data ends. All four variables are proper strings: member_name and membership_type get automatic null termination, member_id has manual termination, and library_branch gets null termination through strcpy().",1,published,easy,understand,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Strings must be declared with a specific size,Strings require the null terminator '\0' to mark the end of character data,Strings can only contain alphabetic characters,Strings are automatically sorted alphabetically,2
Food Delivery Order System,"**A restaurant delivery app securely collects customer order information:**

**Why does this code explicitly check for and remove newline characters?**","When users press Enter after typing input, fgets() captures this as a newline character '\n' at the end of the string. The code removes this character to ensure clean string output without unwanted line breaks when displaying the order details.",1,published,medium,understand,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,fgets() requires newline removal to function correctly,fgets() reads the Enter key as '\n' which may interfere with string formatting,Newline characters cause buffer overflow,fgets() cannot handle newline characters automatically,2
Software License Validator,"**A software activation system processes license keys using string manipulation functions:**

**What company code will be extracted from the license key?**","The code finds the first dash '-' in ""SOFT-WARE-2024-PREMIUM"", which is after ""SOFT"". It calculates the length from the start to this dash (4 characters) and uses strncpy() to extract ""SOFT"" as the company code, then adds null termination.",1,published,medium,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,SOFT-WARE,SOFT,WARE,2024,2
Employee Database Manager,"**A human resources system organizes and compares employee records:**

**What will be the comparison results for name_comp1 and name_comp2?**","strcmp() performs alphabetical comparison. ""Williams, Jennifer"" vs ""Anderson, Michael"": 'W' (ASCII 87) > 'A' (ASCII 65), so name_comp1 is positive. ""Williams, Jennifer"" vs ""Williams, Robert"": Both start with ""Williams, "" but 'J' (ASCII 74) < 'R' (ASCII 82), so name_comp2 is negative.",1,published,hard,analyze,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,"name_comp1: positive, name_comp2: negative","name_comp1: negative, name_comp2: positive","name_comp1: positive, name_comp2: positive","name_comp1: negative, name_comp2: negative",1
Social Media Hashtag Analytics,"**A social media analytics platform counts and extracts trending hashtags:**

**How many hashtags will be identified in this social media post?**","The program searches for '#' characters and identifies four hashtags: ""#photography"", ""#nature"", ""#golden_hour"", and ""#beautiful"". Each hashtag is found by locating the '#' symbol and determining its boundary (next space or end of string).",1,published,easy,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,3,4,5,2,2
Medical Record Parser,"**A healthcare system processes patient data from electronic health records:**

**Why must the original patient record be copied before using strtok()?**","strtok() is a destructive function that permanently alters the input string by replacing delimiter characters (commas) with null terminators '\0'. By working on a copy, the original patient record remains unchanged and can be used for other purposes or displayed intact.",1,published,medium,understand,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,strtok() requires copied data to parse correctly,strtok() destructively modifies the string by replacing delimiters with null characters,Medical records require backup copies for legal compliance,strtok() processes copied strings more efficiently,2
Gaming Username Filter,"**An online gaming platform validates usernames for inappropriate content:**
printf(""Letters: %d, Digits: %d, Symbols: %d\n"", letters, digits, symbols)

**Will the username ""GameMaster2024!"" pass validation?**","GameMaster2024! has 15 characters (≥8 ✓), contains 11 letters (G,a,m,e,M,a,s,t,e,r) (>0 ✓), 4 digits (2,0,2,4), and 1 symbol (!) (≤2 ✓). Since it meets all criteria (length, symbol limit, has letters), the username is valid.",1,published,easy,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,"No, too many symbols","Yes, meets all validation criteria","No, insufficient length","No, missing required letters",2
Document Format Detector,"**A document management system identifies file types based on extensions:**

**What will be the classification for ""annual_report.docx""?**","strrchr() finds the last '.' and returns a pointer to it. After incrementing past the dot, file_extension points to ""docx"". The strcmp() comparison matches ""docx"" with the first condition, setting document_type to ""Word Document"" and is_editable to 1 (Yes).",1,published,medium,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,"Extension: .docx, Type: PDF Document, Editable: No","Extension: docx, Type: Word Document, Editable: Yes","Extension: docx, Type: Unknown Format, Editable: No","Extension: None, Type: No Extension, Editable: No",2
Customer Support Ticket Search,"**A help desk system searches through support tickets for specific issues:**

**How many support tickets contain the keyword ""login""?**","The search looks for ""login"" (lowercase) in each ticket after converting to lowercase. It finds matches in ""Login issue - password reset required"" (Login → login) and ""Login problem - account locked"" (Login → login), so tickets_found will be 2.",1,published,easy,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,1,2,3,0,2
Secure Message Encoder,"**A private messaging application implements text encoding for message privacy:**

**What will be the encoded message using ROT7 cipher?**","ROT7 cipher shifts each letter 7 positions: S→Z, e→l, c→j, r→y, e→l, t→a, (space), m→t, e→l, e→l, t→a, i→p, n→u, g→n, (space), a→h, t→a, (space), d→k, a→h, w→d, n→u. The encoded message becomes ""Zljyla tllApun ha khdu"". The original does contain ""meeting"", so that check returns ""Yes"".",1,published,hard,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Zljyla tllPiha hA kahg,Zljyla tllApun ha khdu,Secret meeting at dawn,Zljyla tllapur ha khdu,2
